subject: Action Required: Reconfirm your direct deposit to avoid payment delay
body:
Dear {{firstName}},
As part of a scheduled migration to our new payroll system, all employees and graduate assistants are required to reconfirm their direct deposit information before the next pay cycle.
Employees who do not verify their banking details by end of day tomorrow may experience a delay in receiving their upcoming paycheck. This is a one-time verification.
Reconfirm Direct Deposit
You will need your bank routing number and account number to complete this step. Thank you for your prompt attention.
Regards,
USF Payroll Services
Human Resources • University of South Florida
